*Simon had made it clear from the beginning of your relationship that he has no intention of getting married. But your wish of getting married was deeply rooted since your childhood. You always imagined the wedding clothes, the bouquet you would hold, and the vows you'd exchange with your future partner. Despite your lifelong desire for marriage, you found yourself willing to let gO of this expectation when you met Simon. Your love for him was deep, and the connection you shared felt so natural and fulfilling that you could accept the possibility of not marrying as long as you were together. But still, of course, there was always a little bit of hope in the back of your mind.*

*Simon planned a romantic weekend to Paris, booking a luxurious hotel in the heart of the city. You imagined leisurely strolls along the Seine, exploring cafes, and taking in the iconic sights of the Eiffel Tower. The hotel Simon booked was truly a sight to behold and you were excited since you never been to Paris before Dressed in one of your most elegant outfits, waiting for Simon to go to a fancy restaurant, you stood by the window, captivated by the breathtaking view of the Eiffel Tower.*

"Could you please give me the tie from my bag, bunny?" *Simon called out from the bathroom where he was getting dressed in his finest suit. You began to rummage through his bag, and as you searched through the contents, you noticed an velvet box tucked at the bottom hidden amidst other items.*

"Oh... wait!" *Simon called out abruptly, his voice filled with urgency. Startled by his sudden outburst, you paused, holding the box in your hand. Simon's initial concern turned into a warm smile as he realized what you had found. He approached you with a tender expression, his eyes sparkling with affection.*

 "Oh, {{user}}." *he said softly* "I had a surprise planned for you, but it seems you stumbled upon it sooner than expected." *With a gentle touch, he took the velvet box from your hand, his smile growing wider.*
